implementation_statement: POL-02 (P06), approved 2026-08-31, now covers OT access including remote and vendor access. OT access procedures (HMI accounts, remote sessions) are due 2026-12-31.

HMI and engineering workstation accounts are local and managed by the SCADA technicians. Gap: HMIs use one shared operator login; OT accounts are not on the HR termination checklist; no periodic review.
The HMI software enforces three privilege levels (view, operate, engineer). Gap: because operators share one login, the operate level cannot be tied to a person.
The IT/OT firewall controls traffic between the business network and the OT network. Gap: broad allow rules for historian traffic, and the historian is dual-homed on both networks.
Operators cannot change PLC logic from the HMI. Gap: the integrator's remote desktop agent runs with administrator rights on the engineering workstation.

The VPN locks an account for 30 minutes after 10 failed attempts, and the engineering workstation locks after 5. OT tailoring per the SP 800-82r3 OT overlay: operator HMIs used for continuous operation do not lock out. Gap: the overlay's example compensating control, logging failed HMI logons and alerting, is not in place until OT log forwarding (AU-12).
evidence: VPN policy; workstation policy; tailoring note

implementation_statement: Add a system use banner to the VPN and the new remote access gateway. Due 2026-10-31.
The engineering workstation and historian server lock after 10 minutes. OT tailoring: operator HMIs stay unlocked in the badge-controlled control room so alarms are never hidden.

Remote access exists through the IT-managed VPN (9 on-call users) and the integrator's remote desktop agent. Gap: both use a password only; the agent is always on; VPN sessions land directly on the HMI subnet. Replacement gateway with MFA, per-session approval, and recording is due 2026-10-31.
The new remote access gateway will record and log every OT session, with weekly review. Due 2026-10-31.
There is no Wi-Fi on the OT network. The licensed radio telemetry has no message authentication; this is accepted until the 2028 radio refresh (P01 R-004).
Security awareness training is given at hire only. Annual training and quarterly phishing simulations start 2026-11.
OT role-based training for operators and SCADA technicians (remote access rules, suspicious HMI behavior, manual fallback) is due 2027-01-31.
Event types to log: HMI logins and setpoint changes, PLC mode changes, remote sessions, firewall denies, VPN logins. Defined in the OT logging standard, due 2026-12-31.

control_name: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
implementation_statement: Weekly review of OT security alerts and remote sessions by the IT Manager, with anomalies reviewed with the Operations Manager. Starts when log forwarding is live (2027-03-31).
SCADA servers sync time from the domain controller. Gap: PLCs and RTUs are not synchronized, which complicates incident timelines.
Firewall logs are kept 7 days and HMI event logs roll over locally. Target: 1 year in the log workspace.
Log generation on HMIs, firewall, VPN, and gateway, forwarded to the log workspace in the cloud tenant. Due 2027-03-31.
First control assessment completed 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-07 (P07) by a contracted assessor. Annual assessments planned.
Continuous monitoring strategy (monthly metrics: remote sessions, exposure scan results, patch status, backup status) due 2027-03-31.
Baseline configurations for SCADA servers, HMIs, PLC firmware, and modems, captured with the OT asset inventory. Due 2026-12-31.
The integrator schedules changes with the Operations Manager. Gap: no written change record, test, or review before loading changes to PLCs or HMIs.
PLC programming requires the engineering software and credentials. Gap: PLC key switches at WTP-1 are in remote-program mode, so logic can be changed over the network at any time.
HMIs use the integrator's 2017 build. Gap: cellular modems had default web administration (fixed 2026-08-06); no hardening standard.
Unused services removed from the historian in 2024. Gap: the engineering workstation runs a remote desktop agent, a web browser, and email client not needed for engineering.
OT asset inventory (model, firmware, location, address, owner) to replace the 2017 as-built list. Due 2026-10-31.

The ERP (2021) covers hurricanes, main breaks, contamination, and chemical release. Gap: no cyber incident or SCADA recovery procedure. The revised ERP is due for certification by 2026-12-26 (internal target 2026-12-11).
Manual operation drills twice a year. Gap: written manual-mode procedures are missing for some chemical feeds.
ERP exercises test hurricanes and main breaks. Gap: no cyber scenario has been exercised. OT cyber tabletop due 2026-11-30.
6 remote sites have cellular in addition to radio; 18 sites have radio only.

Offline, encrypted backups of PLC logic and HMI projects monthly and after every change, stored at WTP-1 and the administration office. The historian replica in the cloud tenant covers process data. Due 2026-10-15.
OT recovery procedure: rebuild HMIs from known-good media, reload and verify PLC logic, return from manual mode in stages. Due 2026-12-11.
Engineers and SCADA technicians have named accounts. Gap: operators share one HMI login.
MFA is enforced for business systems and the cloud console through the identity provider. Gap: none on OT remote access or privileged OT accounts.
MFA for non-privileged remote access (on-call operators) through the identity provider on the new gateway. Due 2026-10-31.
VPN passwords follow the business password standard. Gap: HMI and PLC administrator passwords unchanged since 2017; modems had default credentials.
POL-03 (P06), approved 2026-08-31, covers IT and OT incidents and public notification.
Annual OT cyber tabletop with the integrator; first due 2026-11-30.
OT incident handling per the P08 runbook, including isolation, manual operation, and forensics support through the cyber insurer. Capability depends on logging and backups (2026 Q4 to 2027 Q1).
Primacy agency and Tier 1 notice paths exist. Gap: no cyber reporting contacts (CISA, FBI, insurer) until the P08 matrix is adopted in the ERP.
The P08 runbook for HMI remote-access compromise was approved 2026-08-31. It becomes the ERP cyber annex at the ERP revision.
Preventive maintenance for instruments, PLC batteries, and radios runs from the work order system.
The integrator performs nonlocal maintenance through its remote desktop agent. Gap: no approval, MFA, recording, or session log. Replaced by the gateway (AC-17) by 2026-10-31.
Card access list for both plants reviewed quarterly by the Chief Plant Operators.
Card access at plant doors and the control room; fenced and locked well, booster, and tank sites; control panels in locked rooms or cabinets.
Cameras at both plants; intrusion alarms at remote sites report through RTUs to the control room.
Standby generators at both plants and 10 of 14 wells; SCADA servers on UPS. Gap: 4 wells without generator connections.
This SSP, approved 2026-08-31.
POL-05 rules of behavior approved 2026-08-31; acknowledgments being collected.
Background checks for all hires, including operators.
Business accounts disabled at termination. Gap: local OT and VPN accounts not on the checklist.
Integrator personnel requirements (named staff, screening, notice of departures) at contract renewal, due 2027-01-31.
Security categorization in section 6 of this SSP.
Risk assessment 2026-07-24 (P01), serving as the RRA cyber addendum.
Quarterly external exposure scan (first run in P07) and annual passive OT vulnerability review. Due 2026-12-31.
External services are listed in section 8. Gap: the integrator contract has no security terms.
SCADA servers and engineering workstation run an unsupported OS. Upgrade in the 2027 capital plan; hardening and isolation in the meantime.
IT/OT firewall at WTP-1. Gap: no OT DMZ, dual-homed historian, flat OT subnet. Redesign due 2027-03-31.
VPN and historian replica traffic to the cloud tenant are encrypted. Radio telemetry is not (accepted, P01 R-004).
Chemical feed pumps have hardwired stroke limits and analyzers have independent high/low alarms, so a SCADA failure or manipulation fails to a known, bounded state.
Business endpoints patch automatically. Gap: no OT patches since 2023; VPN firmware 14 months behind. Quarterly vendor-qualified OT patch window starts 2026-Q4.
Antivirus on SCADA servers and HMIs with definitions updated monthly by hand.
Passive OT network monitoring sensor at WTP-1 with alerts to the IT Manager and Operations Manager. Due 2027-03-31.
CISA advisories received. Gap: not checked against an OT inventory.
